## Type of change

<!--
Check all that apply. Use the Conventional Commits type that matches your PR title.
-->

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`) — non-breaking change that fixes an issue
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`) — non-breaking change that adds functionality
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:` or `fix!:`) — fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`) — docs only
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor:`) — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] Performance (`perf:`) — performance improvement
- [ ] Tests (`test:`) — add or fix tests
- [ ] Build / CI (`build:` / `ci:`) — build system or CI
- [ ] Chore (`chore:`) — other

## Checklist

- [ ] 🔒 My PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.)
- [ ] 🔒 My commits are squashed or already follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] 🔒 I ran `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` locally
- [ ] 🔒 I ran `gofmt -l .` and there is no output
- [ ] I updated the CHANGELOG description (auto-generated by release-please)
- [ ] I read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide
- [ ] For large changes (>400 lines), I split this into chained PRs (see below)
